name: 主な入口と詳しい分類を並べたメガメニュー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0112 主な入口と詳しい分類を並べたメガメニュー.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: normalized-original-source-component-crop-570x190. Image 3: secondary-component-preview. Image 4: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Create one Japanese Lighthouse mega-menu component at exactly 570x190, matching the normalized source crop. Image 1 is the original site screenshot for context; Image 2 is the exact source component crop and controls four-column geometry, hierarchy and typography roles; Image 3 is the Japanese preview and controls all visible copy and current content; Image 4 controls palette only. Reproduce only this standalone menu crop: no browser frame, page content, promo card, footer, watermark or outer panel. Preserve four columns and their distinct widths. Column 1: small muted eyebrow 「髪の悩みとケア」, followed by three large bold links 「ヘアケアについて」「抜け毛のケア」「髪のブレンド」. Column 2: bold group heading 「髪の悩み」 with links 「全体的に薄くなった」「ストレスによる抜け毛」「加齢とホルモン」「更年期」; then 「髪のブレンド」 with links 「ビタミンとミノキシジル」「ビオチン配合のグミ」「ビオチンとミノキシジル」「出産後のヘアケア」. Column 3: heading 「ケアの選択肢」 with links 「ミノキシジル内服」「ミノキシジル外用」「ミノキシジルの泡」「まつげのケア」; then 「ヘアケア製品」 with links 「シャンプーとコンディショナー」「保湿用シャンプーとコンディショナー」. Column 4: heading 「髪を健やかに保つ」 with links 「ビオチンのグミ」「シャンプー」「コンディショナー」「ボリューム用シャンプー」「ボリューム用コンディショナー」. Keep exact Japanese text, column order, line breaks and relative hierarchy; preserve Meiryo and clear readable type at this compact 570x190 size. Use comfortable line spacing without oversized headings, empty column gaps or outer whitespace. Pure white canvas and surface, dark slate text with supporting headings in #526173. No green accent, badges, chips, icons, card backgrounds or CTA because these are absent from the Japanese preview. Do not copy the English content or source-only RX/NEW badges. No broad mint, shadow card or decoration.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: No active state or CTA appears in the cropped Japanese menu. Use a pure white surface and dark slate text; do not add green accents, chips, badges or decorative artwork.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION:
The owner says the 354x44 LH07-0025 version was too large/spacious, while the 180x28 version was too compact. Use a comfortable middle with readable Japanese typography and balanced label padding. LH07-0025 v006 at 300x40 is the calibration for that segmented control only; never force this size or the prior 180x28 target onto unrelated components. Follow each component original source for anatomy and component-specific proportions.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at normalized 570x190 against the original crop and Japanese preview; 28 labels, four-column hierarchy, white/slate palette, with source-only badges and promo panel omitted to match the Japanese mock. Candidate image only; native editability and menu behavior are unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
